column2: agreed merge:quitar, but "quite" is also a real noun (bullfighting; "estar al quite"); check whether any share of the occurrences is the noun
agreed merge:julio would file the unit under the same lemma as the month; Spanish also writes joule for the unit, so keep or drop may fit better than a merge
agreed merge:tejido, but this is the feminine participle/adjective of tejer ("etiquetas tejidas"), and tejido is also a separate noun; the target may be tejer
